lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso, with tighter clustering observed in the posterior third of the torso mass compared to the anterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several line segments in the mid-torso region terminate abruptly approximately 75% of the way down the lateral mass, failing to reach the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct white circular spots are visible on the mid-posterior haunch, positioned roughly in a vertical alignment with the primary spot being larger and more superior.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a spiraling lyrate curvature, initiating at a posterior-diagonal vector from the skull and rotating upward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned apical tip occupies approximately 10-15% of the total visible length of the primary horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white transverse chevron marking between the ocular regions and two isolated white spots on the lateral facial plane; distinct contrast transition to ochre-colored lower limbs at the carpal and tarsal joints.
